cleavage agent: On-bead digestion was performed with MS-grade trypsin (Promega) in 50 mmol/L ammonium bicarbonate at 37°C overnight.
enrichment method: GST-LC3 bound glutathione sepharose 4B beads or HA-ORP8 bound agarose beads
To screen LC3 interaction proteins or phosphorylation sites of HA-ORP8 immunoprecipitated from cells, GST-LC3 bound glutathione sepharose 4B beads or HA-ORP8 bound agarose beads were precipitated.
instrument: the eluted peptides were introduced into a Q-Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) via a nano-spray source.
ionization type: the eluted peptides were introduced into a Q-Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) via a nano-spray source.
labeling: a ratio of total ion counts (TIC) signal of phosphorylated peptide to the total peptide was calculated
mass analyzer: An Orbitrap analyzer was used to perform a full-scan MS spectra survey with a resolution of r = 70,000 at m/z 400.
precursor tolerance: Precursor mass tolerance was set to ± 20 ppm
fragment tolerance: fragment mass tolerance was set to ± 0.2 Da.
ptm: Carbamidomethylation of cysteine (+57.021 Da) variable; oxidation of methionine (+15.995 Da) variable; phosphorylation of Serine\threonine\tyrosine variable
Carbamidomethylation of cysteine (+57.021 Da), oxidation of methionine (+15.995 Da) and phosphorylation of Serine\threonine\tyrosine was set as variable modifications.
